dx_dlbcl_gcb.quote: germinal-center B-cell-like (GCB) immunophenotype by the Hans algorithm

stage_iv.quote: Stage IVB (Lugano/Ann Arbor) with B symptoms

stage_extranodal_sites.quote: extranodal deposits in the right kidney (3.2 cm, SUVmax 19.6), left adrenal (2.6 cm, SUVmax 17.2) and hepatic segment VI

stage_b_symptoms.quote: drenching night sweats most nights and 8 kg, about 10%, unintentional weight loss over two months

mol_not_de_not_dh.quote: so this is not a double-hit or triple-hit high-grade B-cell lymphoma; the immunophenotype is also not double-expressor

prog_ipi_high.quote: IPI 5/5 (age >60, stage III/IV, more than one extranodal site, elevated LDH, ECOG 2)

tx_curative_pola_or_rchop.quote: Curative-intent systemic therapy with Pola-R-CHP for 6 cycles

tx_pola_preferred.quote: Pola-R-CHP is a category 1 NCCN preferred regimen

tx_prephase_steroid.quote: I will give a short prednisone pre-phase (100 mg daily for 5 days)

mn_dose_reduced_initial.quote: I do not plan pre-emptive dose reduction

cns_risk_addressed.quote: High risk: CNS-IPI 6/6 (age >60, ECOG >1, elevated LDH, more than one extranodal site, stage III/IV, and renal/adrenal involvement)

cns_staging_mri_csf.quote: I will obtain a baseline contrast-enhanced MRI brain and a lumbar puncture with CSF cytology and flow cytometry before starting therapy

cns_prophylaxis_renal.quote: the absolute benefit of CNS prophylaxis in the rituximab era is modest and not proven in randomized trials

mn_hdmtx_now_despite_aki.quote: with dose reduction or omission if the eGFR remains about 50 or renal involvement worsens

resp_eot_pet_lugano.quote: Response will be assessed by Lugano 2014 criteria with FDG PET-CT

resp_ds45_biopsy.quote: a Deauville 4 residual site should be biopsied because inflammatory uptake can persist
resp_ds45_biopsy.note: Biopsy recommended for Deauville 4 residual; DS5 treated as residual disease without explicit biopsy.

sup_tls_prophylaxis.quote: frequent monitoring of uric acid, potassium, phosphate, calcium and creatinine
sup_tls_prophylaxis.note: IV hydration and allopurinol given, but lab frequency unspecified and not q6-12h.

sup_rasburicase_g6pd.quote: rasburicase if uric acid remains above 8 mg/dL or rises or renal function deteriorates, after G6PD testing
sup_rasburicase_g6pd.note: G6PD checked but rasburicase only conditional; allopurinol is first choice.

sup_gcsf.quote: Pegfilgrastim primary prophylaxis with each cycle.

sup_stop_nsaid.quote: Stop ibuprofen now because of CKD, renal involvement and thrombocytopenia; use acetaminophen

sup_steroid_glucose.quote: Monitor glucose closely because of steroid-induced hyperglycemia

work_hbv_reviewed.quote: HBsAg negative, anti-HBc negative, anti-HBs positive indicates prior immunity, so no antiviral prophylaxis is needed

work_echo_reviewed.quote: the LVEF of 60% and normal global longitudinal strain permit full-dose anthracycline

fit_ecog_disease_related.quote: the ECOG 2 is largely attributable to bulky lymphoma and B symptoms rather than irreversible comorbidity
